svg.title: SENTINEL VISION end-to-end workflow and integration
svg.text: End-to-end workflow and integration diagram · as implemented in the repository (September 2026)
Solid border = implemented Dashed border = planned / future
Dedicated reader thread; grab() without decode when idle
Preview/MJPEG, clip ring buffer, AI slot per camera
AI on/off per camera, rotation when slots are short
Ultralytics YOLO11s · ByteTrack · plate detector + EasyOCR
Per-camera ByteTrack IDs · multi-frame plate voting
Cross-camera vehicle journey · appearance signatures (similarity only)
Restricted zones · watchlists · loitering · risk score
Cooldowns, confidence gates, corroboration before CRITICAL
Alert with reasons, severity, risk factors
CRITICAL alerts open or join an incident
Correlation window groups one vehicle across cameras
Snapshot · event clip · REC recording · evidence record
SHA-256 at capture · integrity check · custody in audit log
Live cameras, AI vision, map, alerts, incidents, investigation
Investigation workspace · vehicle journey · incident evidence package
JSON or PDF, optional plate redaction · signed short-lived tokens
classifies failures, records events, opens problems
DB lock retry with reapply (Self-Heal visible)
5 to 60 min, one probe camera before the rest
CROSS-CUTTING SECURITY (every request, stream and file)
Source: github.com/RuudyLinux/SENTINEL-AI (branch demo-readiness-phase2). Names match the code modules they describe.
